mentions.name: Mini Photo Editor
mentions.description: An open-source, pure JavaScript WebGL image editor that runs in the browser, offering effects, filters, crop, and perspective correction. Built as an alternative to comparable image editing solutions that are closed source.
mentions.problem: Most comparable image editing solutions are closed source.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a pure js webgl image editor with effects, filters, crop & perspective correction, ... oh and it's opensource as unfortunately most comparable solutions are closed sources
